notes: Score = probability of the known-correct output (1.0 is perfect). ZNE is reported as null when added noise did not lower the score (zne_ok false). ci95 = bootstrap interval over shots only. GHZ score counts all-0/all-1 outcomes, so it detects bit flips but not loss of entanglement. Layout 'vendor' is chosen from IBM's reported numbers only. Two-qubit gate errors used for chain selection are measured by repeated-gate decay (includes crosstalk from parallel edges); vendor values are only a fallback.
